content: वर्धमान {%a.%} [वृध्-शानच्] Growing, increasing. .{@-नः@} .²1 The castor-oil plant. .²2 A kind of riddle. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a district (said to be the same as the modern Baradvāna). .²5 Sweet citron. .²6 A particular way of joining hands. .²7 A particular attitude in dancing. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of the 24th Arhat or Jina. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of the elephant who supports the eastern quarter. .{@-नः, -नम्@} .²1 A pot or dish of a particular shape; स्वस्तिकान् वर्धमानांश्च नन्द्यावर्तांश्च काञ्चनान् <ls>Mb. 7. 82. 20</ls>; lid. .²2 A kind of mystical diagram. .²3 A palace or temple built in the form of the above diagram. .²4 A house having no door on the south side. .{@-ना@} <ab>N.</ab> of a district (the modern Baradvāna).
